title: Smoothie of red fruits and yogurt
description: By adding yogurt to this red fruit smoothie, you get a delicious filling breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: red fruit (strawberries, red currants, blueberries, raspberries, ...)

instructions.text: Wash the fruit and remove all stems. Put all ingredients in a blender and blend well.
Pour everything into a glass and finish with a straw. You can also flavor the smoothie with sugar or syrup.
